statusDetail: Chrome navigation reached a Cloudflare "Sorry, you have been blocked" page instead of the character.ai application. The external security block prevents inspection of the target UI, routes, flows, assets, runtime, and interaction states.

page.notes: The application could not be profiled. Only a Cloudflare access-denied response was observable.

artifacts.caption: Desktop recon shows the Cloudflare access-denied page rather than character.ai.
Mobile recon shows the same Cloudflare access-denied page.
Rendered DOM identifies the response as "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" with noindex,nofollow.
Mobile layout metrics for the block page; not evidence about character.ai.
Recon probe records the block message, headings, and sole Cloudflare link.
Atomic 58-check coverage manifest with a planned evidence method for every catalog pair.
Atomic coverage validator output showing 58 blocked checks and an incomplete publication gate.
